# Figure captions (generated by scripts/25_figures.py)

**fig1_partI.** Part I (RQ1), confirmatory run (24,000 episodes; N = 200 fields; 5 patient-grouped folds). (a) Probability of stopping without examining the single critical field, InfoDPP-PAC vs uniform sampling at the same per-episode cost (median 32 fields); 95% Wilson intervals. Dashed: worst-case lower bound 1 − n/N for any strategy without location information (Theorem 3). (b) AUC with which the information-gain term that drives stopping, and the cell-level teacher's relevance score, rank critical above non-critical fields; mean over episodes with 95% bootstrap intervals. Dashed (exploratory, separate 10,000 episodes): the field-level teacher, trained on the pooled embeddings the selector sees.

**fig2_partII.** Part II (RQ2). Smallest number of fields n* that any strategy must examine so that the probability of missing all k critical fields is at most α, for N = 1000 (exact hypergeometric; solid) and the sufficient closed form 1 − α^(1/k) (dotted). By Theorem 3 this is a lower bound for every strategy without location information and is attained by uniform sampling. Values are nearly independent of N (results/part2_v1/nstar_table.csv).

**fig3_partIII.** Part III (RQ3), confirmatory run (12,000 specimens of 500 KU-Optofil cells; α = 0.05; all designs paired on the same specimen). (a) Rate of certifying 'p > θ' when p = θ exactly (the hardest true null), with 95% Clopper–Pearson intervals, log scale; CV = control variate; the uncorrected design ranks fields by classifier score but analyses them as if uniformly sampled. (b, c) Median cells examined until certification (line) and interquartile range (band); specimens that never certify count as 500. Thresholds from ICC 2022 (0.10) and WHO 5th ed. 2022 (0.20) are analysed separately.

**fig4_rq4.** RQ4. (a) Median cells to certify p > 0.10 (95% bootstrap intervals; 500 specimens per point) when the classifier is in distribution (KU-Optofil, cross-fitted) and under acquisition shift (RV-PBS, KU-trained probe). All designs keep false certification ≤ 0.014 at p = θ. (b) False certification at p = θ when cells from uniformly sampled fields are analysed as individual draws. Open markers: E3.1 composites (5 cells per field; scattered, hot0.6, hot1.0; 1,000 specimens each, 95% Clopper–Pearson). Lines: Beta-binomial model at the clustering measured in real bone-marrow monolayer ROIs (17 cells per field). Solid band and line: bias-corrected ICC of the real regions (excess over the permutation null, patient-bootstrap 95% CI; exploratory). Hatched: 95% CI of the raw estimate, shown for comparison (biased upward). Field-level analysis stayed ≤ 0.042 in every condition (not shown). ICC is plotted at 10⁻³ when 0.
